$comment: The What's new sheet shown once after an update (app/whats-new.tsx), and the release notes themselves (constants/releases.ts), one key per line under notes.<version>.
title: What’s new

version.note: Heading for one release's notes; version is "1.0.3".

skipped.note: Beside an older version's heading, when more than one release is shown.

v1_0_4.events: Events: a birthday, a wedding or a night out gets its own budget, like a trip, and stays out of your monthly budgets. Settings → Trips & Events.
v1_0_4.transferPairs: When your bank notifies both sides of a transfer between your own accounts, the two become one transfer to check.
v1_0_4.checklist: Insights: a payments checklist that includes your recurring payments.
v1_0_4.transferAccounts: A new transfer asks for both accounts on one screen, From and To, and swaps them in a tap.
v1_0_4.transferAmounts: Both amounts of a transfer can be typed, so a bank's own rate or a fee is kept as it was.
v1_0_4.themes: Switching themes is instant, with stronger contrast.
v1_0_4.outside: Payments kept outside a trip's budget are now remembered.
v1_0_4.tripTag: A shop visited on a trip no longer hands the trip's tag to what you buy there later.

v1_0_3.language: Choose the language in Settings → Language, or let it follow the phone.
v1_0_3.categories: Ready-made categories follow the language until you rename them.
v1_0_3.themes: Eight colour themes, each light and dark, with an app icon to match: Settings → Theme.
